create.name: Rick Barrett
create.bio:
Rick Barrett has studied and taught the Chinese internal martial arts for more than forty years. His t'ai chi ch'uan teacher was Grandmaster William C. C. Chen, and he studied xingyiquan, yiquan and related styles with Master Fukui Yang, and he has competed and won titles in push hands. Alongside the martial arts he trained for several years in energy work with John Beaulieu and practises polarity therapy, so his teaching treats taiji as a meeting point of body, breath, attention and spirit rather than as exercise alone.

He is based in New York City and, under the name Tai Chi Alchemy, has led workshops around the United States for three decades, including a long-running yearly gathering in Sedona and a five-day meditation retreat at Kripalu. Each Tuesday evening he hosts an open online class on Zoom, recorded for his YouTube channel, where he works through practical exercises in qi cultivation, structure and coherence. His style is hands-on and experimental: he asks students to test ideas in their own bodies rather than take them on trust. His books include Taijiquan: Through the Western Gate, Finding You in a World of It, on meeting others and the world with full presence, and Tai Chi: A Path to Becoming Superconscious.

books.title: Tai Chi: A Path to Becoming Superconscious
books.author: Rick Barrett
books.description: His newest book presents taiji as a route to a wider, more awake state of consciousness. It draws on his decades of practice and teaching to link the form's physical principles with presence and inner coherence.

free_resources.title: A Wee Bit of Alchemy (weekly online class)
free_resources.description: An open hour-long class on Zoom every Tuesday at 8 pm Eastern, exploring the internal arts through practical exercises in qi cultivation and body mechanics. There is no entry charge, with an optional suggested contribution, and recordings go up on his YouTube channel.
